title: documents.php error response
description: Body for every non-200/201 outcome of documents.php. 401 not authenticated; 403 CSRF failed or ACL denied; 400 no patient selected, unknown action, unexpected field, missing file or doc_type, or a rejected upload (reason too_large or not_a_pdf); 404 unknown document; 502 sidecar unavailable or timed out (reason, document_id and status=stored: the file is kept and extract can be retried); 500 internal error. Never contains an exception message, a filename or chart data.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.

reason.description: Fixed code for the client: too_large, not_a_pdf, or a sidecar code (unavailable, timeout, internal, bad_request, schema_mismatch).
